label: Web app + FastAPI server behind axHub's sign-in wall (React/TS + Python, one container, Coolify)

structure.purpose: Project manifest (project-manifest@1): name (= hub folder /projects/<name>), repo, relation to AXF, shared data. Nothing is loaded or compiled without a valid one.
App identity, framework version, targets and the default asset for every slot.
Framework version + template, with a hash of every baked file (src/axf, including the deploy helpers).
The baked framework runtime (engines, React layer, CSS, schemas, libraries) and src/axf/deploy: the shared deploy helpers (axf-deploy@1) the installer sources.
Shared deploy helpers: Coolify run + router labels, axHub wall labels, wall secret, auto-update. Re-bake instead of editing.
Hot-swappable assets, one folder per asset type.
The app's views; nav assets reference them by id.
Binds this app's handlers to the standard action vocabulary.
Browser client for the app's own API (/api): same-origin, token from this browser only when there is no wall.
FastAPI app: /api routes behind the app token or a signed-in hub admin, serves the built web app (dist/).
Who is calling behind axHub's wall: signed X-Auth-* headers (HMAC, 120 s, this host), admin/user, same-origin writes.
Server self-test: token, wall signature, admin vs user, cross-site writes, static files.
One image: Node builds the web app, Python serves it with the API (runs as uid 1000).
VPS installer (root): clone/update, token, image, Coolify + Traefik + the wall, 5-minute auto-update. Sources src/axf/deploy/axf-deploy.sh.

next: npm install && npm run dev   (API: pip install -r server/requirements.txt && APP_TOKEN=dev uvicorn main:app --app-dir server --port 7290)
